svg.style: background: white; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
svg.title: Public | Application access to AI Gateway
svg.desc: Generated by Azure Architecture Diagram Builder MCP render_diagram. Export finishing preserves MCP service positions and connection paths; uses official Azure V24 specialty icons, a generic client glyph, neutral card borders, descriptive badges and a flow legend. A bold arrow and highlighted client-authentication panel identify the application's Entra token plus invocation role OR API-key access, with the official Microsoft Entra ID icon beside the Entra option. PE means private endpoint; MI means managed identity. Private-only refers to gateway/model/selected agent ingress, not all egress.
svg.text: Public | Application access to AI Gateway
Application access: Entra token + invocation role OR API key. Backend access: the gateway's separate managed identity.
Bold blue: client authentication | Blue: model request | Gray dashed: optional application / image | Purple dashed: telemetry
Gateway MI = gateway managed identity. Terraform prepares hosting resources; deploy the agent application separately.
